items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: back in the days when we were with Johnny Monneque

ctx.x: We played the last date in Germany the 15th of December in Offenback and arrived in Brussels, Belgium, to prepare for a television show the 18th. Did and afternoon concert in Liege and one that night in Brussels on the 19th. Came to Paris the 20th and that was the last time I saw Jimmy Wright.

He and I had not gotten along the way we had, back in the days when we were with Johnny Monneque. He was wild and undependable. His playing didn't mean much to me. He was putting on a lot of show, almost playing on his back. A few times he refused to come to rehearsals. As we were going to be off a few days during the Christmas and New Year holidays, Jimmy told me that he was going to the States for that period and would come back before the tour started again. I had signed a contract to continue the tour in…

I engaged Guy Lafitte on tenor to finish the tour and we did the first concert at a British army camp near Dusseldorf the 8th of January and did 22 concerts in as many places without having one day off. Guy could not remain with me after the 31st because of commitments in France, I had a contract for a return engagement in the Faun in Hamburg and as Herman Wilson, my ex-trombonist was still in Germany and available, I engaged him
